data.name: Ishfira
data.gender_notes: Ishfira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful name derived from the Arabic root 'sh-f-r', meaning 'to give' or 'to reward'. In Islamic tradition, Ishfira is a name given to a child as a sign of Allah's blessings and divine favor. The name Ishfira carries the meaning “Gift, reward from Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ishfira usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward from allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying Allah's blessings and divine favor.
data.etymology: Ishfira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, reward from Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ishfira total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
